release_readiness_gate_detail: src/autodev/release_readiness_gate.py shim attempts to load scripts/release_readiness_gate.py via spec.loader.exec_module from a relative path (../scripts/...). When autodev-ai is installed from PyPI, scripts/ does NOT ship inside the wheel (only src/autodev/ does), so the shim cannot find the standalone gate script and raises during _load(). The gate ITSELF (when run from a source tree, `python scripts/release_readiness_gate.py`) works perfectly — 36/36 pass. This is a R5 cleanup: either ship scripts/ in the wheel, OR rewrite the shim to be self-contained.
limitations: typer 0.25.1 dropped the [all] extra; pyproject still declares typer[all]>=0.9 → pip emits 'typer 0.25.1 does not provide the extra all' warning (non-blocking). R5: change to bare `typer>=0.9` since modern typer bundles rich + shellingham already.
python -m autodev.release_readiness_gate fails from PyPI install (shim points at scripts/ which isn't in wheel). Gate itself works from source tree. R5: ship scripts/ in wheel or rewrite shim.
